<div class="mp-section" style="flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
<div style="flex: 1 1 0">
<h2 class="mp-title">About the pack</h2>
'''[[Matcha Flavoured]]''' is a datapack and resource pack for ''Minecraft'' Java Edition, designed so that slower, non-technical players gather as much as players who build farms. [[Hunger]] and [[natural regeneration]] are gone: [[food]] heals and carries potion-like [[intrinsic]]s. A [[death]] costs a [[Crystal Heart|heart]] rather than the player's items. Villagers stop buying goods, new [[alloy]]s and hybrid [[tools]] reshape progression, and [[enchanting]] is crafted instead of random.
</div>
<div class="mp-button-wrapper" style="flex: 0 0 0; margin-top: 12px">
{{Mainpage button|progressive=1|Matcha Flavoured|About the pack}}
{{Mainpage button|Guide for new players|New player guide}}
{{Mainpage button|Changes from vanilla|Changes from vanilla}}
</div>
</div>

<div class="mp-section" style="flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
<div style="flex: 1 1 0">
<h2 class="mp-title">Getting started</h2>
The pack's own [[advancements]] double as a tutorial. A new world starts with [[Kindling|kindling]], a [[Wooden Hoe|wooden hoe]] and cooked grass, then leads through the [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]], [[Copper equipment|copper]] and [[Iron equipment|iron]], to the [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] and [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]]. See [[progression]] for the full path.
</div>
<div class="mp-button-wrapper" style="flex: 0 0 0; margin-top: 12px">
{{Mainpage button|progressive=1|Progression|Progression}}
{{Mainpage button|Installation|Installation}}
</div>

<div class="mp-section">
<h2 class="mp-title">Did you know…</h2>
* … that [[Death|dying]] costs a heart of maximum health rather than the player's items?
* … that there are 47 [[fish]] to catch, each rated from one to four stars in the [[Angler's Almanac]]?
* … that defeating the [[Ender Dragon]] [[Surface|banishes monsters from the surface]]?
* … that [[Sack]]s, the pack's shulker boxes, can be crafted long before [[The End]]?
</div>
